meta.scope: official Train rows only (3360); Train-sub 2856 / Dev 504
meta.label_policy: non-Train label entries are masked to NaN immediately after loading and are never used

split.assignment_rule: sorted scaffold keys -> numpy default_rng(seed).permutation -> greedy add whole groups while not exceeding the target
split.scaffold_definition: rdkit Bemis-Murcko, acyclic molecules keyed by their own SMILES

meta.delta_definition: delta_y = y(G_b) - y(G_a), original lipophilicity units, pair direction fixed by the directory (word_a < word_b)

definitions.type: exact replacement type = (word_a, word_b, cut bond raw attributes)
definitions.coarse_type: (radius-1 identity of word_a, radius-1 identity of word_b, cut bond raw attributes)
definitions.support_requirement: exact type must have at least 2 distinct full contexts in Train-sub for a response record
definitions.sign_consistency: max(#positive, #negative) / n_pairs; direction is the fixed canonical word order, not a chemical direction
definitions.eta2_r1: 1 - within-radius-1-group SS / total SS within the type
definitions.eta2_r2: 1 - within-radius-2-group SS / total SS within the type
definitions.eta2_full: 1 by construction: one real pair per (exact type, full context) cell

exact.note: Pooled within-type ANOVA. The residual after r2 is not identified as measurement noise; it can contain higher-order context or type-by-context interaction.

coarse.note: Pooled within-type ANOVA. The residual after r2 is not identified as measurement noise; it can contain higher-order context or type-by-context interaction.

variance_decomposition.subset: Train-sub pairs whose exact replacement type has >= 2 full contexts

permutation_test_exact_type.note: type labels permuted across pairs; this tests type-level variance, not within-type context stability

variance_decomposition.note: Unweighted in-sample OLS with an intercept. Incremental R2 is descriptive; the transfer check is the out-of-split test.

naive_split_half_exact.note: This statistic is dominated by between-type differences; the permutation null keeps type means and destroys within-type context structure. It is reported only as a negative methodological check, not as evidence of stability.

naive_split_half_coarse.note: This statistic is dominated by between-type differences; the permutation null keeps type means and destroys within-type context structure. It is reported only as a negative methodological check, not as evidence of stability.

noise_floor.reason: No replicate structures and no repeated (exact type, full context) cell; within-type across-context variation mixes effect modification and measurement noise.

definitions.high_support_exact: exact type with >= 3 full contexts in Train-sub
definitions.high_support_coarse: coarse type with >= 5 full contexts in Train-sub
definitions.opposite_sign_contexts: at least one positive and one negative delta in the type's full contexts

notes: All deltas are label differences on real matched pairs; they are associational contrasts, not chemical causal effects.
The full context is the whole environment of the cut, not a local approximation; within a type, each full context contributes exactly one pair.
Many exact types have exactly one context; their mean delta is not a repeatable estimate and is kept only in the support table.
The coarsening to radius-1 attachment identity increases support but mixes distinct exact fragment replacements; it is a sensitivity level, not the primary type.
